chapter_note: This chapter is dominantly narrative/dialogue frame with apostolic biography (Mani by the river). The cosmological substrate appears in fragments: (a) the "five-fold cosmos" comparison of humans to mountains/sea (i=11-30), heavily damaged but structurally substratic — mapping humanity → cosmic geography; (b) brief mention of "power that bears the All" and Sophia (i=33-35, 41-42); (c) the enumerated "five things Jesus revealed" (i=68-74) which preserves classic substratic structure (Light kind, aeons, Darkness, death-boundary, fetters); (d) three matters in which faithful live (i=84-90) which is more ecclesial-application but has Cross of Light. Heavy damage (~83%) limits certainty. Strong editorial fatigue drift (+6.9 in apostolic_dialogue) confirms second-half is mostly Mani-Jesus narrative. The dominant frame is the Mani-disciple Q&A built around Jesus's salvific mission — late editorial.
